Chapter 6475: Nine Paragons

Chapter 6475: Nine Paragons

“Okay, show me your paragon power then.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I don’t need to.” The lord was unbeatable in his dream and declared: “Nine power sources here, come for it.”

“I am here.” One figure leaped into the air with his kingdom, looking like a meteor.

Nine endless realms floated around his kingdom. His paragon power floated like water in a constant cycle - something different from Eight-armed Immortal Child and Skyraiser Ancestor.

The gods in his kingdom varied in appearance and size. One had a celestial body with numerous stars flowing within. Another was massive and omnipresent like a rainbow in the sky. One more had an illusory form with fiendish images pulsing in and out of existence...

The figure might not be stronger than Skyraiser in terms of cultivation. However, his form and kingdom in Paragon looked able to absorb any amount of power.

“Nine-turns Sage.” Alch-deer and the others recognized him.

He was a pillar of Trinity, a heaven-slayer. His master was none other than Trinity. He had met Moshi before and was only one step away from the return path.

Rumor has it his dao could accommodate any power influx. Now, everyone believed the rumor after seeing his form.

“You may have all nine.” The lord of Paragon generously gave him all nine power sources - samsara, life and death, yin and yang, karma...

The samsara power contained time. The life-and-death power showed countless beings living and dying. The karmic power controlled fate itself...

“Boom!” Paragon seemingly exploded after a blinding bang.

The sage’s nine realms expanded at a rapid rate, absorbing the power like a whale drinking water. Other primal ancestors couldn’t handle the influx but his realms did the impossible.

Nine new gods were born and shared the same nine realms as him.

“Ahh!” The sage roared and channeled the powers to himself before splitting into nine boundless beings, each imbued with one paragon power.

Everyone was amazed at the limitless potential of the lord’s power blessing.

“So that’s one way of containing the paragon powers.” Alch-deer murmured.

Paragon power appeared easier to obtain than golden power. Of course, the requirement was having a suitable vessel that wouldn’t crack under pressure.

“Nine as one, extinguish.” The sage spoke softly.

The nine figures became resplendent and surrounded Li Qiye with their billowing powers.

“Extinguish.” His voice became the lord’s voice.

The nine attacked, shattering space and time around Li Qiye. The force of life and death attempted to erase Li Qiye’s life and vitality. Nothing could stop it, for it was a paragon.

The samsara power pulled Li Qiye inside, turning him into a crow and then a young shepherd. Karma then took over, subjecting him to its whims. Other affinities joined in at the same time to deliver the greatest harm.

“This looks bad!” Alch-deer shouted since the nine affinities could bring someone back to their most vulnerable state.

“Is this it?” Nevertheless, Li Qiye didn’t bother to stop them as he dispersed into dust specks.

He became nothing while the nine powers took over the area. Nine-turns Sage stared at the scene in confusion, unaware of the result.
